001: Ivan, do you go to any club at the university?
Yes, I'm in the chess club on Tuesdays.
Wow, that's interesting. And how long have you been going there?
Almost a year now, I really like the atmosphere.
It's great that you found something you enjoy.
Come by and watch sometime, if you want.
002: Did you sign up for the photography club we talked about?
Yes, I went to the first class yesterday, and I liked it.
And what did you do there?
We studied the camera settings and took some simple pictures.
Sounds exciting. Can I see your work?
Of course, I'll show you at the end of the week.
003: Dmitry, do you know if we have a theater studio?
I do, it meets on Thursdays in the assembly hall.
And can you still sign up for it?
I think so, the instructor is always happy to see new people.
Great, I was just wanting to try it.
Then let's go together to the next class.
004: Do you go to the robotics classes?
Yes, we meet every Saturday morning.
And what are you building there?
Right now we're making a small robot that follows a line.
That must be really difficult, right?
It was tough at first, but now I've figured it out.
005: Olga, do you want to join the book club?
This month we're discussing a novel by Dostoevsky.
I was just wanting to reread it. When is the meeting?
On Friday after classes, in the library.
Then I'll definitely come, thanks for telling me.
006: Sergey, do you go to a sports club?
Yes, I play volleyball twice a week.
Of course, we have people who just started.
I feel a bit awkward that I'm not good at playing.
Don't worry, we all started from scratch at some point.
007: Did you know we have a foreign language club?
Yes, I've been going there for a few months now.
Really? And what languages do you study there?
Mostly English and German, but there are others too.
That's a great opportunity to practice.
Come on Wednesday, it's a very friendly group.
008: Maria, did you sign up for the dance group?
Yes, I go to modern dance classes on Mondays.
Is it hard to balance with your studies?
Sometimes it's tough, but I really enjoy it.
The main thing is that you're having fun.
I agree, it helps me take my mind off studying.
009: Alexey, do you take part in the volunteer club?
Yes, we help at the animal shelter on weekends.
That's a very noble cause. And what do you do there?
We feed the dogs, walk them, and clean the enclosures.
I'd like to help too. Can I join you?
Of course, we're always happy to have new helpers.
010: Elena, do you go to the cooking club?
Yes, I signed up last month, and I really like it.
And what have you learned to cook so far?
We made pies, salads, and even Italian pasta.
That sounds delicious! Can I try some?
Come to the tasting on Saturday, there will be lots of treats.
